context:
Goal: PR 2860 (a failing job wakes the batch runner) reaches main.
Problem (rule): the PR's lane lint reads UNKNOWN because the shared bin/ci-job on main cannot read the draft flag inside an `if:`, and the fix that adds that reader is in the same PR, so the lint cannot pass until it merges.
Based on (read): the consultant says the route is `merge --lane-lint 2860 --lint-unknown-ok "<reason>"`; the batch runner and the lane refuse that flag without your own word, and the coordinator gives no check-lifting flag.
Based on (read): coordinator relay, 04:55 CST Nov 16 (not read by triage): the lane artifact-pages-other-account handed pull request 6c6b3ef3 in claude-settings to runner 11, and its lane lint passed only with `--lint-unknown-ok` because the draft had no CI run. The flag was used unprompted. The coordinator told the lane and runner 11 to lint again without it. The consultant also uses the flag; the coordinator refuses it.
Based on (ruling): your answer a at 21:01 CST Nov 13, which let this flag be used one PR at a time in the five child repos (q_max, banchi, mailaudit, ios-adblock, joyous); PR 2860 is in claude-settings, not a child repo, so that answer does not cover it. Only option a lifts a check.
Departs from: main — the lane lint blocks PR 2860 as UNKNOWN; option a lets it merge past that check once, option b adds the draft-flag reader to main in a separate PR so the check can pass, option c keeps the block.
Meanwhile: only PR 2860 waits; no other PR depends on it.

options.gain: PR 2860 (a failing job wakes the batch runner) reaches main now.
options.how: You type your yes in the batch runner's chat; the runner then merges with the flag and the reason "this PR adds the draft-field reader to bin/ci-job; main's copy cannot read it yet".
options.label: Grant the lint-unknown flag once for PR 2860
options.lose: One lint check is lifted for one PR.

options.gain: No check is lifted for anyone.
options.how: The consultant opens a separate small PR that carries only the draft-flag reader (the fix, commit ce9db4590, already shown red then green); once it merges, PR 2860 lints clean.
options.label: Ship the reader as its own small PR first
options.lose: One more PR to build, review and merge before 2860 moves.

options.gain: Nothing is lifted and no new PR is made.
options.how: Nothing changes; the lane stays where it is.
options.label: Leave PR 2860 parked
options.lose: The red-job wake for the batch runner stays unbuilt.

title: PR 2860 cannot pass its lint until a reader it adds merges: grant the lint flag once, ship the reader first, or leave it parked?
why: The coordinator recommends b: it lifts no check. It is the coordinator's ask, not owner-typed.
